text:
ben-support: forwarding a customer escalation — ACME reported a massive spike on their invoice after using our bulk embeddings CSV upload. They say dashboard usage looks normal but invoice shows ~9x embeddings charged. attaching their csv and sample request below (redacted).

lina-analytics: thanks — can you paste their sample curl and csv snippet? also include any invoice screenshot (s3 link) if available.

ben-support: sample curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -F 'file=@acme_inputs.csv' \n  -F 'model=embed-small-v2'
```
csv sample (first 3 rows):
```
text,id
"Short blurb about product A",row_1
"Longer description that gets truncated at 1024 tokens...",row_2
"",row_3
```
They attached invoice PDF: https://s3.redwood.internal/acme/invoice-2026-02.pdf (private).

raj-eng: quick hypothesis: bulk CSV path goes through the async batch worker which does per-row accounting. two things to check: 1) are we double-counting when fallback quantization applies (dim changes) and 2) batch-splitting logic may be emitting incorrect per-input multipliers when a row is empty or truncated.

marie-sre: saw a similar hit last quarter where empty rows produced a "zero-dim" placeholder and our metering pipeline counted them as full-size vectors due to a legacy fallback. please dump the metering events for their account for the invoice period.

ben-support: pulled metering events (redacted). snippet: 
```
{ account: "acme", event_type: "embedding_generated", count: 12000, vector_dim: 1536, quantized: false }
{ account: "acme", event_type: "embedding_generated", count: 98000, vector_dim: 0, quantized: true }
```
This looks suspicious — many events with vector_dim: 0.

lina-analytics: that vector_dim: 0 is the smoking gun. Our billing aggregator multiplies by vector_dim/256 (billing unit). If a row produces dim=0 due to a parsing/trim edgecase, we currently coerce to default_upper_dim (1536) before summing, which would inflate charges if that coercion path triggers unintentionally.

raj-eng: root cause likely in the async CSV ingest path: when we encounter rows that are all-whitespace or get truncated to empty after tokenization, the embedding worker returns an error placeholder (dim=0) but the metering pipeline upstream maps error placeholders to the model's nominal dim. because the bulk path batches tens of thousands of rows, a few thousand placeholders -> big invoice delta.

ozzy-billing: confirming: invoice math uses summed (vector_dim_units * count). if placeholders are coerced to 1536 units we overcharge. we need to correct metering replay and issue credit.

ben-support: customer says they did not intentionally send blank rows; looks like their CSV exporter may have produced trailing empty lines. asking for repro steps.

raj-eng: repro steps to run locally:
1) create csv with many blank lines and some long inputs that will be truncated.
2) POST to /v1/embeddings/batch (same form-file flow)
3) watch batch worker logs: look for "placeholder-dim-0" entries and check emitted metering events (kafka topic: embeddings-meter).
Log grep example:
```
grep placeholder-dim-0 /var/log/redwood/emb-worker.log | tail -n 50
```

marie-sre: temporary mitigation: update metering-aggregator to ignore events with vector_dim == 0 (treat as zero charge) until we push a proper fix. will open a hotfix PR and a credit flow for impacted accounts.

lina-analytics: small follow-up — we should also check pairwise/rerank path: if they used rerank after embedding, per-pair accounting can also multiply charges when dims mismatch. can someone confirm ACME used rerank?

ben-support: customer confirms they ran a rerank step after embedding to score pairs — attached their rerank request example.

raj-eng: rerank uses pairwise accounting (n_results * base_cost). if embeddings for some rows are placeholders, the rerank step still iterates pairs and uses the placeholder vector_dim in the cost calc — compounding the overcharge. that explains the 9x factor.

ozzy-billing: action items: 
- issue immediate credit for the inflated portion (estimate pending analytics).
- schedule metering-aggregator hotfix to ignore dim==0 events for invoices in-flight.
- patch async worker to emit explicit error events and avoid placeholder->coerce path.

ben-support: I notified customer that we are investigating and will credit them. they asked for a reproducible minimal test they can run to confirm fix.

raj-eng: provide them a sample script that dedups blank lines client-side and returns 204 for empty rows. quick example we can share: 
```python
import csv
with open('clean.csv','w') as out, open('acme_inputs.csv') as inp:
  w=csv.writer(out)
  for r in csv.reader(inp):
    if any(cell.strip() for cell in r):
      w.writerow(r)
```

lina-analytics: I'll run analytics to compute exact overcharge and add to the support ticket.

marie-sre: PR #4821 created for metering-aggregator hotfix, rolling to canary now. deploy-bot: started canary deploy.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for metering-aggregator (revision: agg@v2.14.3-hotfix). monitoring hooks enabled.

ben-support: thanks team. I'll keep ACME updated and attach the sample dedupe script. once canary looks clean, please advise and we'll process credits. :handshake:

lina-analytics: will post final numbers in this thread in ~2 hours.

raj-eng: follow-up note for records: add a unit test for bulk CSV ingest that simulates blank rows + truncation and asserts emitted metering event uses dim==0 flagged as error instead of coercion.

ben-support: (closing loop) customer replied: "thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround, please keep us posted." :thumbsup:
